lines.text: Many learners say: Yesterday I go to school.
Better: Yesterday I went to school.
Yesterday means the past. Use went.
Went! Yesterday she went to work.

data.why: Yesterday means the past. Use went.

native.tip: 英语动词要随时间变化：昨天用 “went”，不是 “go”。

en.tip: English verbs change with time: after yesterday use “went”, not “go”.
en.caption: Do you say “Yesterday I go to school”? 😅 In English, past events need a past verb: “Yesterday I went to school”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
